summary: Verified expanded Convert-to-Property visibility rule (button now on ALL non-converted lead sources) plus prefill copy tweak. Backend lead_convert suite: 8/8 PASS. UI: Convert button correctly appears on contact_form, inspection_form, sell_form unconverted rows (Alice + TEST_LO + TEST_Insp7 verified). Prefill descriptions correctly say 'Original contact:' and include 'Source: <src>'. Alice sell_form still yields full property prefill (title=Waigani apartment, price=450000, map_coords=-9.4235,147.1856, suburb=Waigani). Alice left in 'new' state so user sees live Convert button.

ui_bugs.issue: Visibility rule spec says 'rows with status=converted must NOT have Convert button', but code uses `alreadyConverted = status==='converted' && property_id`. Orphan leads with status='converted' but property_id=null (e.g. TEST_UP and Test rows in current DB) still show Convert button and lack view-property link. Only affects data-anomaly rows (converted without a linked property) but is a spec deviation.
